                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body cnblogs-markdown">
<section id="mp-md" style="-webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased; text-autospace: normal; text-align: left; color: rgba(92, 97, 102, 1); background-color: rgba(252, 252, 252, 1); font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Roboto, &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.6; padding: 1.5em 1em"><p style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0 0 1em; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.8"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">在日常数据处理工作中，将 Python 列表结构的数据导出为 Excel 文件是极为常见的需求。无论是数据分析结果输出、业务报表生成，还是接口数据落地，Excel 凭借其良好的可读性和广泛的兼容性，始终是数据交付的主流格式。</span></p>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0 0 1em; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.8"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">本文基于 Free Spire.XLS for Python 免费库，从一维列表、二维列表到字典列表三种典型场景，逐步讲解列表到 Excel 的转换实现。</span></p>
<hr style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 1.5em 0; border-top: 2px solid rgba(230, 232, 235, 1); border-right: none; border-bottom: none; border-left: none; border-radius: 2px">
<h2 style="box-sizing: border-box; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.35; margin: 0.3em 0; font-weight: 600; font-size: 1.35em; color: rgba(252, 252, 252, 1); background-color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); padding: 2px 12px; border-radius: 4px; display: inline-block"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">环境准备</span></h2>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0 0 1em; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.8"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">Free Spire.XLS for Python 是一款独立的 Excel 处理组件，无需依赖 Microsoft Office 环境，支持 .xls 与 .xlsx 格式的创建与编辑。免费版对工作表数量和数据行数有一定限制，适用于中小规模数据导出场景。</span></p>
<h3 style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 1.2em 0 0.5em; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.35; font-weight: 600; font-size: 1.2em; color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1)"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">安装方式</span></h3>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0 0 1em; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.8"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">通过 pip 直接安装免费版本：</span></p>
<pre style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 1em 0; padding: 1.2em; background-color: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1); border-radius: 10px; overflow-x: auto; line-height: 1.6"><code class="language-bash" style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; word-break: break-all; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); color: inherit; padding: 0; border: none; border-radius: 0; font-size: 0.875em; line-height: 1.5">pip install Spire.Xls.Free
</code></pre>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0 0 1em; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.8"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">安装完成后，在代码中引入核心模块：</span></p>
<pre style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 1em 0; padding: 1.2em; background-color: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1); border-radius: 10px; overflow-x: auto; line-height: 1.6"><code class="language-python" style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; word-break: break-all; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); color: inherit; padding: 0; border: none; border-radius: 0; font-size: 0.875em; line-height: 1.5"><span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(217, 39, 146, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">from</span> spire.xls <span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(217, 39, 146, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">import</span> *
<span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(217, 39, 146, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">from</span> spire.xls.common <span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(217, 39, 146, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">import</span> *
</code></pre>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0 0 1em; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.8"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">核心对象包括 </span><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 0.9em; background-color: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1); color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); padding: 2px 4px; border-radius: 3px; word-break: break-all">Workbook</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">（工作簿）、</span><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 0.9em; background-color: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1); color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); padding: 2px 4px; border-radius: 3px; word-break: break-all">Worksheet</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">（工作表）和 </span><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 0.9em; background-color: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1); color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); padding: 2px 4px; border-radius: 3px; word-break: break-all">CellRange</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">（单元格区域），三者构成了 Excel 操作的基础层级。</span></p>
<hr style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 1.5em 0; border-top: 2px solid rgba(230, 232, 235, 1); border-right: none; border-bottom: none; border-left: none; border-radius: 2px">
<h2 style="box-sizing: border-box; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.35; margin: 0.3em 0; font-weight: 600; font-size: 1.35em; color: rgba(252, 252, 252, 1); background-color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); padding: 2px 12px; border-radius: 4px; display: inline-block"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">场景1：一维列表导出单列数据</span></h2>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0 0 1em; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.8"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">一维列表是最简单的数据结构，通常对应 Excel 中的单列数据，例如产品名称列表、员工工号序列等。</span></p>
<h3 style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 1.2em 0 0.5em; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.35; font-weight: 600; font-size: 1.2em; color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1)"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">实现思路</span></h3>
<ol style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0 0 1em; padding-left: 2em; list-style-type: decimal">
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0 0 0.4em; line-height: 1.7"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">创建工作簿并获取工作表</span></li>
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0 0 0.4em; line-height: 1.7"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">遍历列表，按行索引依次写入单元格</span></li>
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0 0 0.4em; line-height: 1.7"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">调整列宽以优化显示效果</span></li>
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0 0 0.4em; line-height: 1.7"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">保存文件并释放资源</span></li>
</ol>
<h3 style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 1.2em 0 0.5em; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.35; font-weight: 600; font-size: 1.2em; color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1)"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">完整代码</span></h3>
<pre style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 1em 0; padding: 1.2em; background-color: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1); border-radius: 10px; overflow-x: auto; line-height: 1.6"><code class="language-python" style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; word-break: break-all; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); color: inherit; padding: 0; border: none; border-radius: 0; font-size: 0.875em; line-height: 1.5"><span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(217, 39, 146, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">from</span> spire.xls <span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(217, 39, 146, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">import</span> *
<span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(217, 39, 146, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">from</span> spire.xls.common <span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(217, 39, 146, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">import</span> *
<p><span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(217, 39, 146, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">def</span> <span class="hljs-title function_" style="color: rgba(55, 135, 199, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">list_to_single_column</span>(<span class="hljs-params" style="color: rgba(103, 107, 121, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">data_list, output_path, sheet_name=<span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(13, 125, 108, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">"数据"</span></span>):<br>
<span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(13, 125, 108, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">"""将一维列表导出为Excel单列数据"""</span><br>
<span class="hljs-comment" style="color: rgba(103, 107, 121, 1); font-style: italic; box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"># 创建工作簿</span><br>
workbook = Workbook()<br>
<span class="hljs-comment" style="color: rgba(103, 107, 121, 1); font-style: italic; box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"># 清除默认工作表，新建指定名称的工作表</span><br>
workbook.Worksheets.Clear()<br>
sheet = workbook.Worksheets.Add(sheet_name)</p>
<p><span class="hljs-comment" style="color: rgba(103, 107, 121, 1); font-style: italic; box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"># 遍历列表写入单元格，从第1行第1列开始</span><br>
<span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(217, 39, 146, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">for</span> index, value <span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(217, 39, 146, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">in</span> <span class="hljs-built_in" style="color: rgba(118, 65, 187, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">enumerate</span>(data_list):<br>
sheet.Range[index + <span class="hljs-number" style="color: rgba(118, 65, 187, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">1</span>, <span class="hljs-number" style="color: rgba(118, 65, 187, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">1</span>].Value = <span class="hljs-built_in" style="color: rgba(118, 65, 187, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">str</span>(value)</p>
<p><span class="hljs-comment" style="color: rgba(103, 107, 121, 1); font-style: italic; box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"># 自动调整列宽</span><br>
sheet.AllocatedRange.AutoFitColumns()</p>
<p><span class="hljs-comment" style="color: rgba(103, 107, 121, 1); font-style: italic; box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"># 保存为xlsx格式</span><br>
workbook.SaveToFile(output_path, ExcelVersion.Version2016)<br>
workbook.Dispose()</p>
</code><p><code class="language-python" style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; word-break: break-all; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); color: inherit; padding: 0; border: none; border-radius: 0; font-size: 0.875em; line-height: 1.5"><span class="hljs-comment" style="color: rgba(103, 107, 121, 1); font-style: italic; box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"># 调用示例</span><br>
<span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(217, 39, 146, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">if</span> <strong>name</strong> == <span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(13, 125, 108, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">"<strong>main</strong>"</span>:<br>
products = [<span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(13, 125, 108, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">"笔记本电脑"</span>, <span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(13, 125, 108, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">"机械键盘"</span>, <span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(13, 125, 108, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">"无线鼠标"</span>, <span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(13, 125, 108, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">"27寸显示器"</span>, <span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(13, 125, 108, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">"外接硬盘"</span>]<br>
list_to_single_column(products, <span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(13, 125, 108, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">"single_column.xlsx"</span>)<br>
</code></p></pre><p></p>
<h3 style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 1.2em 0 0.5em; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.35; font-weight: 600; font-size: 1.2em; color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1)"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">要点说明</span></h3>
<ul style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0 0 1em; padding-left: 2em; list-style-type: disc">
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0 0 0.4em; line-height: 1.7"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">行号与列号均从 1 开始计数，这与 Excel 的原生索引方式一致</span></li>
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0 0 0.4em; line-height: 1.7"><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 0.9em; background-color: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1); color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); padding: 2px 4px; border-radius: 3px; word-break: break-all">Value</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"> 属性会自动将输入转为字符串存储，若需保留数值类型可使用 </span><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 0.9em; background-color: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1); color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); padding: 2px 4px; border-radius: 3px; word-break: break-all">NumberValue</code></li>
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0 0 0.4em; line-height: 1.7"><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 0.9em; background-color: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1); color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); padding: 2px 4px; border-radius: 3px; word-break: break-all">AutoFitColumns()</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"> 方法根据内容自动调整列宽，避免内容被截断</span></li>
</ul>
<hr style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 1.5em 0; border-top: 2px solid rgba(230, 232, 235, 1); border-right: none; border-bottom: none; border-left: none; border-radius: 2px">
<h2 style="box-sizing: border-box; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.35; margin: 0.3em 0; font-weight: 600; font-size: 1.35em; color: rgba(252, 252, 252, 1); background-color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); padding: 2px 12px; border-radius: 4px; display: inline-block"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">场景2：二维列表导出结构化表格</span></h2>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0 0 1em; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.8"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">二维列表（列表嵌套列表）是最接近 Excel 表格结构的数据形式，每一个子列表对应一行数据，通常配合表头使用。</span></p>
<h3 style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 1.2em 0 0.5em; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.35; font-weight: 600; font-size: 1.2em; color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1)"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">实现思路</span></h3>
<ol style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0 0 1em; padding-left: 2em; list-style-type: decimal">
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0 0 0.4em; line-height: 1.7"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">分离表头与数据行，分别写入</span></li>
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0 0 0.4em; line-height: 1.7"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">双层循环遍历二维列表，按行列坐标写入单元格</span></li>
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0 0 0.4em; line-height: 1.7"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">对表头区域应用基础样式，增强可读性</span></li>
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0 0 0.4em; line-height: 1.7"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">批量自适应列宽</span></li>
</ol>
<h3 style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 1.2em 0 0.5em; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.35; font-weight: 600; font-size: 1.2em; color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1)"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">完整代码</span></h3>
<pre style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 1em 0; padding: 1.2em; background-color: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1); border-radius: 10px; overflow-x: auto; line-height: 1.6"><code class="language-python" style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; word-break: break-all; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); color: inherit; padding: 0; border: none; border-radius: 0; font-size: 0.875em; line-height: 1.5"><span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(217, 39, 146, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">from</span> spire.xls <span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(217, 39, 146, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">import</span> *
<span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(217, 39, 146, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">from</span> spire.xls.common <span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(217, 39, 146, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">import</span> *
<p><span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(217, 39, 146, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">def</span> <span class="hljs-title function_" style="color: rgba(55, 135, 199, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">list_2d_to_excel</span>(<span class="hljs-params" style="color: rgba(103, 107, 121, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">headers, data_rows, output_path, sheet_name=<span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(13, 125, 108, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">"数据表"</span></span>):<br>
<span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(13, 125, 108, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">"""将二维列表导出为带表头的Excel表格"""</span><br>
workbook = Workbook()<br>
workbook.Worksheets.Clear()<br>
sheet = workbook.Worksheets.Add(sheet_name)</p>
<p><span class="hljs-comment" style="color: rgba(103, 107, 121, 1); font-style: italic; box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"># 写入表头（第1行）</span><br>
<span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(217, 39, 146, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">for</span> col_idx, header <span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(217, 39, 146, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">in</span> <span class="hljs-built_in" style="color: rgba(118, 65, 187, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">enumerate</span>(headers):<br>
cell = sheet.Range[<span class="hljs-number" style="color: rgba(118, 65, 187, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">1</span>, col_idx + <span class="hljs-number" style="color: rgba(118, 65, 187, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">1</span>]<br>
cell.Value = header<br>
<span class="hljs-comment" style="color: rgba(103, 107, 121, 1); font-style: italic; box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"># 表头样式：加粗、背景色</span><br>
cell.Style.Font.IsBold = <span class="hljs-literal" style="color: rgba(118, 65, 187, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">True</span><br>
cell.Style.Color = Color.get_LightBlue()<br>
cell.Style.HorizontalAlignment = HorizontalAlignType.Center</p>
<p><span class="hljs-comment" style="color: rgba(103, 107, 121, 1); font-style: italic; box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"># 写入数据行（从第2行开始）</span><br>
<span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(217, 39, 146, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">for</span> row_idx, row_data <span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(217, 39, 146, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">in</span> <span class="hljs-built_in" style="color: rgba(118, 65, 187, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">enumerate</span>(data_rows):<br>
<span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(217, 39, 146, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">for</span> col_idx, value <span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(217, 39, 146, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">in</span> <span class="hljs-built_in" style="color: rgba(118, 65, 187, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">enumerate</span>(row_data):<br>
<span class="hljs-comment" style="color: rgba(103, 107, 121, 1); font-style: italic; box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"># 根据数据类型选择写入方式</span><br>
cell = sheet.Range[row_idx + <span class="hljs-number" style="color: rgba(118, 65, 187, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">2</span>, col_idx + <span class="hljs-number" style="color: rgba(118, 65, 187, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">1</span>]<br>
<span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(217, 39, 146, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">if</span> <span class="hljs-built_in" style="color: rgba(118, 65, 187, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">isinstance</span>(value, (<span class="hljs-built_in" style="color: rgba(118, 65, 187, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">int</span>, <span class="hljs-built_in" style="color: rgba(118, 65, 187, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">float</span>)):<br>
cell.NumberValue = <span class="hljs-built_in" style="color: rgba(118, 65, 187, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">float</span>(value)<br>
<span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(217, 39, 146, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">else</span>:<br>
cell.Value = <span class="hljs-built_in" style="color: rgba(118, 65, 187, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">str</span>(value)</p>
<p><span class="hljs-comment" style="color: rgba(103, 107, 121, 1); font-style: italic; box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"># 添加边框</span><br>
data_range = sheet.Range[<span class="hljs-number" style="color: rgba(118, 65, 187, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">1</span>, <span class="hljs-number" style="color: rgba(118, 65, 187, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">1</span>, <span class="hljs-built_in" style="color: rgba(118, 65, 187, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">len</span>(data_rows) + <span class="hljs-number" style="color: rgba(118, 65, 187, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">1</span>, <span class="hljs-built_in" style="color: rgba(118, 65, 187, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">len</span>(headers)]<br>
data_range.BorderAround(LineStyleType.Thin)<br>
data_range.BorderInside(LineStyleType.Thin)</p>
<p><span class="hljs-comment" style="color: rgba(103, 107, 121, 1); font-style: italic; box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"># 自适应列宽</span><br>
sheet.AllocatedRange.AutoFitColumns()</p>
<p>workbook.SaveToFile(output_path, ExcelVersion.Version2016)<br>
workbook.Dispose()</p>
</code><p><code class="language-python" style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; word-break: break-all; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); color: inherit; padding: 0; border: none; border-radius: 0; font-size: 0.875em; line-height: 1.5"><span class="hljs-comment" style="color: rgba(103, 107, 121, 1); font-style: italic; box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"># 调用示例</span><br>
<span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(217, 39, 146, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">if</span> <strong>name</strong> == <span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(13, 125, 108, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">"<strong>main</strong>"</span>:<br>
headers = [<span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(13, 125, 108, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">"员工ID"</span>, <span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(13, 125, 108, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">"姓名"</span>, <span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(13, 125, 108, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">"部门"</span>, <span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(13, 125, 108, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">"月薪"</span>, <span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(13, 125, 108, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">"在职状态"</span>]<br>
employees = [<br>
[<span class="hljs-number" style="color: rgba(118, 65, 187, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">1001</span>, <span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(13, 125, 108, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">"张明"</span>, <span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(13, 125, 108, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">"研发部"</span>, <span class="hljs-number" style="color: rgba(118, 65, 187, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">15000</span>, <span class="hljs-literal" style="color: rgba(118, 65, 187, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">True</span>],<br>
[<span class="hljs-number" style="color: rgba(118, 65, 187, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">1002</span>, <span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(13, 125, 108, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">"李华"</span>, <span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(13, 125, 108, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">"产品部"</span>, <span class="hljs-number" style="color: rgba(118, 65, 187, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">13500</span>, <span class="hljs-literal" style="color: rgba(118, 65, 187, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">True</span>],<br>
[<span class="hljs-number" style="color: rgba(118, 65, 187, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">1003</span>, <span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(13, 125, 108, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">"王芳"</span>, <span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(13, 125, 108, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">"设计部"</span>, <span class="hljs-number" style="color: rgba(118, 65, 187, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">12800</span>, <span class="hljs-literal" style="color: rgba(118, 65, 187, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">False</span>],<br>
[<span class="hljs-number" style="color: rgba(118, 65, 187, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">1004</span>, <span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(13, 125, 108, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">"赵强"</span>, <span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(13, 125, 108, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">"测试部"</span>, <span class="hljs-number" style="color: rgba(118, 65, 187, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">11500</span>, <span class="hljs-literal" style="color: rgba(118, 65, 187, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">True</span>]<br>
]<br>
list_2d_to_excel(headers, employees, <span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(13, 125, 108, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">"employee_table.xlsx"</span>)<br>
</code></p></pre><p></p>
<h3 style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 1.2em 0 0.5em; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.35; font-weight: 600; font-size: 1.2em; color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1)"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">技术细节</span></h3>
<ul style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0 0 1em; padding-left: 2em; list-style-type: disc">
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0 0 0.4em; line-height: 1.7"><strong style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-weight: 600; color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1)">数据类型区分</strong><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">：数值型数据使用 </span><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 0.9em; background-color: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1); color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); padding: 2px 4px; border-radius: 3px; word-break: break-all">NumberValue</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"> 写入，可在 Excel 中参与公式计算；字符串使用 </span><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 0.9em; background-color: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1); color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); padding: 2px 4px; border-radius: 3px; word-break: break-all">Value</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"> 属性</span></li>
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0 0 0.4em; line-height: 1.7"><strong style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-weight: 600; color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1)">区域批量操作</strong><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">：通过 </span><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 0.9em; background-color: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1); color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); padding: 2px 4px; border-radius: 3px; word-break: break-all">sheet.Range[行1, 列1, 行2, 列2]</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"> 获取矩形区域，可一次性设置边框、对齐方式等样式</span></li>
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0 0 0.4em; line-height: 1.7"><strong style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-weight: 600; color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1)">布尔值处理</strong><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">：直接写入时会显示为 TRUE/FALSE，若需自定义显示文本需转换为字符串</span></li>
</ul>
<hr style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 1.5em 0; border-top: 2px solid rgba(230, 232, 235, 1); border-right: none; border-bottom: none; border-left: none; border-radius: 2px">
<h2 style="box-sizing: border-box; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.35; margin: 0.3em 0; font-weight: 600; font-size: 1.35em; color: rgba(252, 252, 252, 1); background-color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); padding: 2px 12px; border-radius: 4px; display: inline-block"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">场景3：字典列表导出为 Excel</span></h2>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0 0 1em; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.8"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">字典列表是业务开发中最常见的数据结构，例如数据库查询结果、API 响应数据等，每条记录以键值对形式存在。</span></p>
<h3 style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 1.2em 0 0.5em; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.35; font-weight: 600; font-size: 1.2em; color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1)"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">实现思路</span></h3>
<ol style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0 0 1em; padding-left: 2em; list-style-type: decimal">
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0 0 0.4em; line-height: 1.7"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">从首条数据提取键名作为表头</span></li>
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0 0 0.4em; line-height: 1.7"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">遍历每条字典记录，按键的顺序写入对应列</span></li>
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0 0 0.4em; line-height: 1.7"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">支持空值容错处理</span></li>
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0 0 0.4em; line-height: 1.7"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">对数值、布尔等特殊字段做类型区分写入</span></li>
</ol>
<h3 style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 1.2em 0 0.5em; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.35; font-weight: 600; font-size: 1.2em; color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1)"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">完整代码</span></h3>
<pre style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 1em 0; padding: 1.2em; background-color: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1); border-radius: 10px; overflow-x: auto; line-height: 1.6"><code class="language-python" style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; word-break: break-all; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); color: inherit; padding: 0; border: none; border-radius: 0; font-size: 0.875em; line-height: 1.5"><span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(217, 39, 146, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">from</span> spire.xls <span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(217, 39, 146, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">import</span> *
<span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(217, 39, 146, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">from</span> spire.xls.common <span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(217, 39, 146, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">import</span> *
<p><span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(217, 39, 146, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">def</span> <span class="hljs-title function_" style="color: rgba(55, 135, 199, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">dict_list_to_excel</span>(<span class="hljs-params" style="color: rgba(103, 107, 121, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">dict_list, output_path, sheet_name=<span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(13, 125, 108, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">"数据"</span>, custom_headers=<span class="hljs-literal" style="color: rgba(118, 65, 187, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">None</span></span>):<br>
<span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(13, 125, 108, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">"""将字典列表导出为Excel表格"""</span><br>
<span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(217, 39, 146, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">if</span> <span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(217, 39, 146, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">not</span> dict_list:<br>
<span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(217, 39, 146, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">raise</span> ValueError(<span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(13, 125, 108, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">"数据列表不能为空"</span>)</p>
<p>workbook = Workbook()<br>
workbook.Worksheets.Clear()<br>
sheet = workbook.Worksheets.Add(sheet_name)</p>
<p><span class="hljs-comment" style="color: rgba(103, 107, 121, 1); font-style: italic; box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"># 确定表头：优先使用自定义表头，否则使用字典键名</span><br>
<span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(217, 39, 146, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">if</span> custom_headers:<br>
headers = custom_headers<br>
keys = <span class="hljs-built_in" style="color: rgba(118, 65, 187, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">list</span>(dict_list[<span class="hljs-number" style="color: rgba(118, 65, 187, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">0</span>].keys())<br>
<span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(217, 39, 146, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">else</span>:<br>
keys = <span class="hljs-built_in" style="color: rgba(118, 65, 187, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">list</span>(dict_list[<span class="hljs-number" style="color: rgba(118, 65, 187, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">0</span>].keys())<br>
headers = keys</p>
<p><span class="hljs-comment" style="color: rgba(103, 107, 121, 1); font-style: italic; box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"># 写入表头</span><br>
<span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(217, 39, 146, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">for</span> col_idx, header <span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(217, 39, 146, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">in</span> <span class="hljs-built_in" style="color: rgba(118, 65, 187, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">enumerate</span>(headers):<br>
cell = sheet.Range[<span class="hljs-number" style="color: rgba(118, 65, 187, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">1</span>, col_idx + <span class="hljs-number" style="color: rgba(118, 65, 187, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">1</span>]<br>
cell.Value = header<br>
cell.Style.Font.IsBold = <span class="hljs-literal" style="color: rgba(118, 65, 187, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">True</span><br>
cell.Style.HorizontalAlignment = HorizontalAlignType.Center</p>
<p><span class="hljs-comment" style="color: rgba(103, 107, 121, 1); font-style: italic; box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"># 写入数据</span><br>
<span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(217, 39, 146, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">for</span> row_idx, item <span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(217, 39, 146, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">in</span> <span class="hljs-built_in" style="color: rgba(118, 65, 187, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">enumerate</span>(dict_list):<br>
<span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(217, 39, 146, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">for</span> col_idx, key <span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(217, 39, 146, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">in</span> <span class="hljs-built_in" style="color: rgba(118, 65, 187, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">enumerate</span>(keys):<br>
cell = sheet.Range[row_idx + <span class="hljs-number" style="color: rgba(118, 65, 187, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">2</span>, col_idx + <span class="hljs-number" style="color: rgba(118, 65, 187, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">1</span>]<br>
value = item.get(key, <span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(13, 125, 108, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">""</span>)</p>
<p><span class="hljs-comment" style="color: rgba(103, 107, 121, 1); font-style: italic; box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"># 根据类型智能写入</span><br>
<span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(217, 39, 146, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">if</span> value <span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(217, 39, 146, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">is</span> <span class="hljs-literal" style="color: rgba(118, 65, 187, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">None</span>:<br>
cell.Value = <span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(13, 125, 108, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">""</span><br>
<span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(217, 39, 146, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">elif</span> <span class="hljs-built_in" style="color: rgba(118, 65, 187, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">isinstance</span>(value, <span class="hljs-built_in" style="color: rgba(118, 65, 187, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">bool</span>):<br>
cell.BooleanValue = value<br>
<span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(217, 39, 146, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">elif</span> <span class="hljs-built_in" style="color: rgba(118, 65, 187, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">isinstance</span>(value, (<span class="hljs-built_in" style="color: rgba(118, 65, 187, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">int</span>, <span class="hljs-built_in" style="color: rgba(118, 65, 187, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">float</span>)):<br>
cell.NumberValue = <span class="hljs-built_in" style="color: rgba(118, 65, 187, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">float</span>(value)<br>
<span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(217, 39, 146, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">else</span>:<br>
cell.Value = <span class="hljs-built_in" style="color: rgba(118, 65, 187, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">str</span>(value)</p>
<p><span class="hljs-comment" style="color: rgba(103, 107, 121, 1); font-style: italic; box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"># 格式优化</span><br>
data_range = sheet.Range[<span class="hljs-number" style="color: rgba(118, 65, 187, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">1</span>, <span class="hljs-number" style="color: rgba(118, 65, 187, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">1</span>, <span class="hljs-built_in" style="color: rgba(118, 65, 187, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">len</span>(dict_list) + <span class="hljs-number" style="color: rgba(118, 65, 187, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">1</span>, <span class="hljs-built_in" style="color: rgba(118, 65, 187, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">len</span>(headers)]<br>
data_range.BorderAround(LineStyleType.Thin)<br>
data_range.BorderInside(LineStyleType.Thin)<br>
sheet.AllocatedRange.AutoFitColumns()</p>
<p>workbook.SaveToFile(output_path, ExcelVersion.Version2016)<br>
workbook.Dispose()</p>
</code><p><code class="language-python" style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; word-break: break-all; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); color: inherit; padding: 0; border: none; border-radius: 0; font-size: 0.875em; line-height: 1.5"><span class="hljs-comment" style="color: rgba(103, 107, 121, 1); font-style: italic; box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"># 调用示例</span><br>
<span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(217, 39, 146, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">if</span> <strong>name</strong> == <span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(13, 125, 108, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">"<strong>main</strong>"</span>:<br>
orders = [<br>
{<span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(13, 125, 108, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">"order_id"</span>: <span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(13, 125, 108, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">"ORD2024001"</span>, <span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(13, 125, 108, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">"product"</span>: <span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(13, 125, 108, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">"笔记本支架"</span>, <span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(13, 125, 108, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">"quantity"</span>: <span class="hljs-number" style="color: rgba(118, 65, 187, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">2</span>, <span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(13, 125, 108, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">"price"</span>: <span class="hljs-number" style="color: rgba(118, 65, 187, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">89.9</span>, <span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(13, 125, 108, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">"status"</span>: <span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(13, 125, 108, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">"已发货"</span>},<br>
{<span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(13, 125, 108, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">"order_id"</span>: <span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(13, 125, 108, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">"ORD2024002"</span>, <span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(13, 125, 108, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">"product"</span>: <span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(13, 125, 108, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">"USB集线器"</span>, <span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(13, 125, 108, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">"quantity"</span>: <span class="hljs-number" style="color: rgba(118, 65, 187, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">5</span>, <span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(13, 125, 108, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">"price"</span>: <span class="hljs-number" style="color: rgba(118, 65, 187, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">45.0</span>, <span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(13, 125, 108, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">"status"</span>: <span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(13, 125, 108, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">"待出库"</span>},<br>
{<span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(13, 125, 108, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">"order_id"</span>: <span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(13, 125, 108, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">"ORD2024003"</span>, <span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(13, 125, 108, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">"product"</span>: <span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(13, 125, 108, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">"散热底座"</span>, <span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(13, 125, 108, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">"quantity"</span>: <span class="hljs-number" style="color: rgba(118, 65, 187, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">1</span>, <span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(13, 125, 108, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">"price"</span>: <span class="hljs-number" style="color: rgba(118, 65, 187, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">129.0</span>, <span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(13, 125, 108, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">"status"</span>: <span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(13, 125, 108, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">"已签收"</span>},<br>
]<br>
dict_list_to_excel(orders, <span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(13, 125, 108, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">"orders.xlsx"</span>, sheet_name=<span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(13, 125, 108, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">"订单数据"</span>)<br>
</code></p></pre><p></p>
<h3 style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 1.2em 0 0.5em; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.35; font-weight: 600; font-size: 1.2em; color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1)"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">设计考量</span></h3>
<ul style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0 0 1em; padding-left: 2em; list-style-type: disc">
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0 0 0.4em; line-height: 1.7"><strong style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-weight: 600; color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1)">类型分发逻辑</strong><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">：通过 </span><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 0.9em; background-color: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1); color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); padding: 2px 4px; border-radius: 3px; word-break: break-all">isinstance</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"> 判断数据类型，分别调用 </span><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 0.9em; background-color: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1); color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); padding: 2px 4px; border-radius: 3px; word-break: break-all">BooleanValue</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">、</span><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 0.9em; background-color: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1); color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); padding: 2px 4px; border-radius: 3px; word-break: break-all">NumberValue</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">、</span><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 0.9em; background-color: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1); color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); padding: 2px 4px; border-radius: 3px; word-break: break-all">DateTimeValue</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"> 等属性，保证数据在 Excel 中以正确类型存储</span></li>
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0 0 0.4em; line-height: 1.7"><strong style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-weight: 600; color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1)">空值处理</strong><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">：字典中不存在的键或值为 None 时，写入空字符串，避免报错</span></li>
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0 0 0.4em; line-height: 1.7"><strong style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-weight: 600; color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1)">字符串兜底</strong><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">：所有未匹配到的类型统一转为字符串写入，确保导出不中断</span></li>
</ul>
<hr style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 1.5em 0; border-top: 2px solid rgba(230, 232, 235, 1); border-right: none; border-bottom: none; border-left: none; border-radius: 2px">
<h2 style="box-sizing: border-box; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.35; margin: 0.3em 0; font-weight: 600; font-size: 1.35em; color: rgba(252, 252, 252, 1); background-color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); padding: 2px 12px; border-radius: 4px; display: inline-block"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">总结</span></h2>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0 0 1em; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.8"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">将 Python 列表导出为 Excel 的核心在于数据结构到表格结构的映射。一维列表对应单列、二维列表对应行列矩阵、字典列表对应键值结构化记录，三种场景覆盖了绝大多数业务需求。</span></p>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.8"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">在实际开发中，建议根据数据规模和格式要求选择合适的写入方式：简单场景直接遍历写入，复杂场景封装为通用函数并补充类型判断与异常处理，可有效提升代码复用性与健壮性。</span></p></section>

</div>
